senses.gloss: (corresp. to b. h. אסר) to harness for war, to prepare battle.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 20:14">Targ. I Kings XX, 14</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 15:5">Targ. I Sam. XV, 5</cite> <he>וטַ׳ וכ׳</he> he arranged his camp (h. text <he>וירב</he>); a. fr.
Targ. II Kings XXII, 4 (Af.); ib. 9 (ed. Wil. טְקִיסוּ Pe.).—
Ib. XXIII, 35 (h. text נגש).—Part. pass. מְטַקַּס arranged, fitted, joined.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 12:12">Ib. XII, 12</cite>.
Targ. I Kings VI, 31 (h. text חמשית). Targ. II Esth. V, 1 מט׳ trimmed

Targ. Ps. XX, 6 נִיטְקָס Ms. (ed. Ven. a. Levita נִיטְקֵס; Bxt. a. oth. נְטַקַּס, read נִיטּ׳; h. text נדגל). [Targ. Is. XIII, 17, v. טְפַס.] Targ. I Kings VI, 7 מִטַּ׳ Levita, closely fitted stones (ed. מַטְקַס noun; h. text מסע); cmp. מַטְכְּסָא. [Some of the meanings of טקס a. of טכס are influenced by the Greek τάσσω, τάξις.]
